# Fluffy Pancakes

Weekend pancakes.

## Ingredients

- 1 1/2 cups flour
- 1 tbsp sugar
- 1 egg
- 1 cup milk

## directions

Whisk everything together.

Fry ladles of batter in a buttered pan until golden on both sides.

## Nutrition

- Calories: 210
- Protein: 6 g

| Per serving | Amount |
|---|---|
| Fat | 7 g |
